notes: Stored edit with background-belief queries, adapted from the template examples/geography-replace-0003 with the review's fixes (scouting/geography.review.md). Derivability very_unlikely: 'Canberra is the capital of Australia' is stated hundreds of times verbatim and follows from no other fact. Worlds: two independent storage choices (Parliament by name or as 'in the capital'; embassies by name or by the rule 'embassies are in the capital'), combined into four. Dropped route: 'the capital of Australia is in the Australian Capital Territory' as a stored description would put Sydney in the ACT, contradicting 'Sydney is in New South Wales', so the state query is determinate (README step 3). R1 choices: 'federal Parliament' rather than 'Parliament House' (the NSW Parliament House is in Sydney); 'the foreign embassies' rather than the US Embassy ('US embassy in Sydney' is real usage for the consulate); the High Court is avoided because it also sits in other state capitals. Counts re-checked 2026-10-25 through the shared infini-gram helper; quotes checked in Wikipedia plain-text extracts.
